description: Audit a stylesheet's typography. Pass `css` (free) or a public `url` (Pro). Reads font-size, the font shorthand and line-height, converts rem and em with the root size the CSS sets, and reports: every size with its use count, the modular ratio that best explains the sizes (major second to octave, with the share of sizes it covers) or that none fits, sizes that fall off that ratio, pairs less than 2px or 10% apart, the number of distinct sizes against a budget of 8, the body size (under 16px is flagged, under 14px is high), text under 12px, and line heights that are tight, loose or wrong for the size. Fluid sizes written with clamp() or vw are counted but not placed on the scale.

css.description: CSS text to read (a stylesheet, or several concatenated). Free up to 100,000 characters; Pro up to 2,000,000.

url.description: Pro only. Public page whose linked and inline stylesheets are fetched (up to 12 sheets, 5 MB).

name: audit_type_scale
title: Type scale audit
